text: Landed on main as 92c3236 + b4f26b1. The second commit fixes fresh-context review findings: init wording, LinkageError mapped to LayoutMeasurementFailed, sub-pixel ink readout. API: JavaFxTextMetrics() (widthPt = logical advance, heightPt = ascent+descent, inkBounds, resolvedFamily); core TextExtent.rotated/measure/anchored/deviceDegrees, which DeviceScene lowering now uses. Evidence (macOS, headless Monocle sw, coverage-weighted sub-pixel readout): advance error 0.012 px; line box 0.039 px; inkBounds edges 0.61 px for real faces; rotated plate vs TextExtent 0.027 px JavaFX and 0.011 px Java2D, glyphs inside the extent. Exception: JavaFX synthesized bold (System bold on macOS) over-paints 1.64 px at 24 px past inkBounds; this is documented and asserted at <=0.1 x size. Not proven: Canvas (no drawn-pixel check; em-box vs heightPt caveat and fallback-glyph growth documented); Linux CI fonts not yet measured (1 px bounds now have ~0.4-0.99 px headroom). AWT vs JavaFX difference documented in docs/backends.md (macOS: Arial 24 pt 2.08 pt over one label; logical SansSerif 16 pt). Gates at b4f26b1: testAll 17/17 (2402 tests, 0 failures), check-docs 0 errors, check-compatibility pass.
